1.title: Service Trust Portal and Privacy Principles
1.text: Welcome to Module eleven: Service Trust Portal and Privacy Principles. It covers the exam area Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Describe the Service Trust Portal. Describe Microsoft's privacy principles. Describe the Microsoft Pree va capabilities. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions (twenty to twenty-five percent). Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Service Trust Portal (STP)
1.text: Service Trust Portal (S T P). The Service Trust Portal is Microsoft's public site for compliance documentation about its cloud services. It shows how Microsoft protects data and how its services meet standards. Sign in with a Microsoft account (or work account) to download. Audit reports and certifications. I S O or I E C twenty-seven thousand one, S O C one, two and three, fed ramp, P C I D S S. Compliance guides. How to use Microsoft services to meet G D P R and other rules. Security assessments and white papers. Penetration test results, risk assessments. Data protection resources. Information on where data is stored and handled. My Library. Save documents and get update notifications.

1.title: Service Trust Portal (STP), continued
1.text: Service Trust Portal (S T P). The figure shows this: The Service Trust Portal: audits, certifications, guides and data protection resources. Exam tip: "Where do I find Microsoft's audit reports (S O C, I S O) for my auditor?" equals Service Trust Portal. It documents Microsoft's compliance, while Compliance Manager (module twelve) tracks yours.

1.title: Microsoft privacy principles
1.text: Microsoft privacy principles. Microsoft commits to six privacy principles. Control. You control your data, with tools to make choices. Transparency. Microsoft is clear about how data is collected and used. Security. Data is protected with strong security and encryption. Strong legal protections. Respect for local privacy laws and fight for privacy as a human right. No content-based targeting. Customer email, chat, files are not used to target ads. Benefits to you. Data collection must bring value to you.

1.title: Microsoft privacy principles, continued
1.text: Microsoft privacy principles. The figure shows this: Six privacy principles: control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting, benefits to you. Exam tip: Memorize the six: control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting, benefits. "Does not use customer content for advertising" equals no content-based targeting.

1.title: Microsoft Priva
1.text: Microsoft Pree va. Microsoft Pree va helps organizations protect personal data and meet privacy rules. Privacy Risk Management. Finds personal data in Microsoft three sixty-five, spots risks (such as data overexposure, transfers or hoarding) and suggests remediation. Subject Rights Requests. Handles data subject requests (find, export, delete personal data) under rules like G D P R with a guided workflow. Privacy Assessments. Help assess privacy impact of projects. Consent management. Tracks consent. Exam tip: Pree va equals privacy. Subject rights request equals a person asks "what data do you hold about me?" or "delete it." Pree va finds personal data and tracks the response.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors' auditor asks for Microsoft's S O C two report. Where can the company get it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Service Trust Portal. The Service Trust Portal hosts Microsoft's audit reports and certifications.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which Microsoft privacy principle states that customer email is not used to target advertising? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: No content-based targeting. Customer content is not used for content-based advertising.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A customer asks a company to find and delete all personal data it holds about them. Which Pree va capability helps? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Subject Rights Requests. Subject Rights Requests supports finding and exporting or deleting personal data.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which solution finds personal data and risks such as overexposure in Microsoft three sixty-five? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Pree va Privacy Risk Management. Privacy Risk Management identifies personal data and privacy risks.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. How many privacy principles does Microsoft state? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Six. Microsoft lists six privacy principles.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which principle means people can make choices about their data using tools? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Control. Control means customers manage their own data and choices.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the Service Trust Portal? Answer: Microsoft's site for compliance documents, audit reports and guides. Question two. Name the six privacy principles. Answer: Control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting and benefits to you. Question three. What is Pree va? Answer: Microsoft's privacy management solution for personal data.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does a subject rights request ask for? Answer: Access to, export of, or deletion of a person's data. Question five. What feature saves documents in the portal? Answer: My Library. Question six. Which regulation do subject rights requests relate to? Answer: G D P R (and similar privacy laws).

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Service Trust Portal: Microsoft's audit reports (I S O, S O C, fed ramp), compliance guides, white papers; My Library. Privacy principles: control, transparency, security, strong legal protections, no content-based targeting, benefits. Pree va: Privacy Risk Management; Subject Rights Requests. In the next module, we continue the course.
